role: integrations/puredarwin/m1-keyboard/protocol is an independent checker. The hardware candidate links native_protocol only. This receipt did not edit native_protocol.

approved_root_engine.r1: APPROVED. deliver() accepts declared payload + 10 <= reassembled length. CRC stays at the real end. payload_length is the declared length.

fix: assemble() no longer takes remain; the caller already stores offset+length+remain in span. test_copy now passes sizeof of an 8-byte destination. The earlier call claimed capacity 100 for a 4-byte array and ASan aborted.
protocol_semantics: Padding: payload_len+10 <= length is delivered; the payload length is the declared value. payload_len+10 > length is REJECT.
Unrelated input during a fragment (bad packet CRC, length under 10 that is not boot, bad single-message CRC, unknown flags) leaves the prefix in place.
A continuation whose device does not match abandons the prefix. A changed total does not.
A final fragment shorter than 10 bytes is REJECT and the prefix stays open.
Descriptor payload 513 is REJECT after reassembly, with no payload. Payload 512 is delivered.
CRC-valid a0 80 00 00 is BOOT before flags and before an 8-byte header. The four bytes are returned and an open fragment continues.
